description: Classifies an utterance with a pretrained Model2Vec static-embedding classifier head trained on the OVOS v5 intent corpus. The head is frozen: it emits only labels it was trained on, and never learns from the templates a skill registers.
notes: English head emitting 198 of the corpus's 208 labels, measured from the pinned commit; the rest are counted against it. Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate, shipped plugin defaults elsewhere.
